prompts.V1:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit image 1 only. Image 1 is the edit target: a 360x260 native pixel cemetery crop enlarged by EXACT 4x nearest to 1440x1040. Image 2 is STYLE reference only: the existing 96px RPG hero enlarged 8x; match its clean hard pixel clusters and selective material-dark contour edges. Image 3 is ground palette/block-pattern reference only; do NOT copy its paths/layout.
DELIVER ONE EXACT 1440x1040 RGB IMAGE that depicts a 360x260 native pixel design enlarged exactly 4x. ALL visible steps and color boundaries must snap to a 4x4 output-pixel grid, origin(0,0). Each 4x4 cell uniformly one color. No antialiasing, no tiny output-level detail. Do not draw a pixel grid. Do not add a character.
V1 CONSERVATIVE STYLE REPAIR. Retain identical spatial composition to image 1: large open rectangular grave near top center, displaced slab lid to its right; broken masonry wall upper right, upright headstone at right midheight, cross stone lower right, iron railing and low wall along bottom right, cropped masonry and railing bottom edge; open muddy ground on left. Keep exact positions silhouettes size and crop. Make the smallest artistic simplification needed to MATCH THE HERO, not a photograph reduced to pixels.
Redraw stone as geometric readable 3/4 planes with selective deep stone-grey edge pixels at silhouette turns and joints, using its own darkest material shade, never a black outline around everything. Tomb rim needs especially crisp dark lower/right-facing edges and broad lit tops. Iron uses charcoal dark material rims, dull grey light facets, clear 1-native-pixel stems. Keep recognizable bricks but delete granular chips, speckles and tiny random highlights.
Every material gets exactly 4 deliberate tones (dark edge, shadow, mid, lit), at most one highlight. Six material families: stone warm-grey, iron muted charcoal, earth cool grey-brown, water grey-slate low saturation, grass muted olive-tan, inner grave very dark earth. Prefer 24-28 colors total. No continuous shading or smooth gradients.
Ground: retain original puddle placement concept but consolidate into broad cold grey muted slate mud patches and low saturation blue-grey puddles. On LEFT HALF where the brown-coated hero will be composited later, make quiet cool-grey mud, almost no random pebbles. Sparse grass in grouped 3-5px clusters around objects only. Remove 80 percent of tiny ground noise. Keep V1 textural richness via medium size intentional clusters, not single-pixel pepper.
Upper left light through material planes; NO ground cast shadows, no glow, no saturated cyan or blue anywhere, no language marks, no lettering, no border, no annotations. Do not change camera or invent new objects. Remember native 360x260 encoded at exactly 4x blocks: output 1440x1040.
prompts.V2:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit image 1 only. Image 1 is a 360x260 native cemetery crop, EXACT 4x nearest enlargement to 1440x1040; preserve this layout exactly. Image 2, the existing hero enlarged 8x, is the pixel style reference, not an object to draw. Image 3 is the ground block/palette reference only.
Output EXACT 1440x1040 image containing a native 360x260 pixel design at EXACT 4x zoom: every 4x4 output cell one solid color, every shape edge snaps to the same 4px grid. NO intermediate subcell pixels, antialiasing or smooth painting. Do NOT draw characters.
V2 BOLD STYLIZATION. Make a visibly different simplification strength from the original: clean classic mature RPG pixel art; BIG COLOR CLUSTERS and broad simple forms, NOT a filtered photo, NOT painterly. Preserve open grave top center, displaced stone lid on right, upper-right broken brick wall, right headstone, lower-right cross headstone, bottom-right low wall and iron fence, bottom cropped railing, quiet muddy left floor. Same exact framing and object positions.
Redraw every object with confidently stepped silhouettes and selective dark edge shading taken from each material's OWN darkest ramp shade. Deep grey for stone edges, charcoal for iron, deep earthy grey for pit; no universal black outline or all-around thick stroke. On stone: each face is mostly one broad solid tone with 1-2 deliberate secondary clusters, each brick reads as a single chunky shape. Headstone face 2 broad planes, one restrained crack max; no mottling. Tomb rim 4 broad planes, dark inner lip, lid one large plane with a restrained bevel. Iron uprights precise native1px line, few deliberate highlights.
EXACTLY 4 shades per material family, 6 families (24 colors target), no extra blended shades: stone grey-beige 4, iron charcoal-grey 4, cool grey mud 4, low saturation slate puddles4, dead olive-tan grass4, dark grave earth4. Upper-left surface lighting. Preserve dark fantasy maturity, do not turn cute or chibi.
Ground is 65 percent cool slightly grey mud in big interlocking quiet patches and 25 percent low saturation slate-grey shallow water, remaining sparse dead grass near object feet. Avoid repeated texture tiles. Eliminate 95 percent of pebble/speckle detail; ground is calm and flat enough for a 96px brown-coated hero to stand out, without outlines on hero. No ground cast shadows, saturated cyan, saturated blue, glow, runes, text, UI, grid overlay, border, props added or layout redesign. Native360x260 at4x=1440x1040.
